mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(AMOUNT * 100, 0)), 0) FROM ( SELECT SUM(NVL(SHARE_AMT, 0)) AS AMOUNT FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE SPLIT_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND IS_CANCEL != 'Y' GROUP BY SPLIT_TRADE_ID UNION ALL SELECT SUM (NVL(SHARE_AMT, 0)) AS AMOUNT FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE SPLIT_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND IS_CANCEL != 'Y' GROUP BY SPLIT_TRADE_ID )

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL FPD INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD FPAD ON FPD.TRADE_ID = FPAD.TRADE_ID WHERE FPD.INV_AIM != #{turnInvAim,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FPAD.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioIdEn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FPD.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WTP INNER JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD WTPA ON WTP.TRADE_ID = WTPA.TRADE_ID WHERE WTP.INV_AIM != #{turnInvAim,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND WTPA.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioIdEn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND WTP.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ETR_ENTRUST EE WHERE EE.INV_AIM != #{turnInvAim,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EE.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioIdEn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EE.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM WFL_ETR_ENTRUST WE WHERE WE.INV_AIM != #{turnInvAim,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND WE.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioIdEn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND WE.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ETR_ENTRUST EE INNER JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL ED ON EE.ENTRUST_ID = ED.ENTRUST_ID WHERE EE.INV_AIM != #{turnInvAim,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ED.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioIdEn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EE.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM WFL_ETR_ENTRUST WE INNER JOIN WFL_ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL WED ON WE.ENTRUST_ID = WED.ENTRUST_ID WHERE WE.INV_AIM != #{turnInvAim,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND WED.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioIdEn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND WE.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) FROM DUAL

FP.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND TFPDT.TRADE_DATE = TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=DATE},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TFPDT.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND TFPDT.IS_CANCEL = #{NO}
